How do I use it properly the very first time?
Good place to start. The first time is very simple.
Unbox the plant right away and check the soil. If the top 2 inches feel dry, you can water. If it feels damp, wait until it dries.
Open the reservoir lid on the pot.
Pour lukewarm water into the reservoir and leave a small gap at the top so it does not spill.
Close the lid and place the plant in the light recommended on the care card.
After that, you only need to check the reservoir about once a month.
